is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. and Anopheles funestus s.l. (Page 1, Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper mentions that 'Intense pyrethroid resistance associated with the almost fixed (≥80%) 995F kdr mutation, and overexpression of cytochrome P450 genes have been found in An. gambiae s.l.' (Page 3), but this refers to previous studies [16, 24, 25]. The current study does not report new genotype data for these or any other resistance markers.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper does not report any genotype counts or frequencies for insecticide resistance markers.

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted in the Tiébissou district, Côte d’Ivoire (Page 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting entomological data collected in 2023.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted in the Tiébissou district, Côte d’Ivoire (Page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections were conducted between July and August 2023 (Page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a new entomological study conducted in 2023.

supplement.evidence: The paper does not report any genotype data, so no supplementary genotype data is needed.

assessment.summary: This study characterizes malaria vector populations (An. coluzzii, An. gambiae s.s., and An. funestus) in the Tiébissou district of Côte d’Ivoire prior to a randomized controlled trial of new ITNs. It reports entomological indicators (HBR, SIR, EIR) but does not perform or report any new insecticide resistance marker genotyping.
exclusion_reasons: reports_target_markers: The paper does not report any new genotype data for insecticide resistance markers.
reports_extractable_genotype_data: The paper does not report any genotype counts or frequencies for insecticide resistance markers.
